title: Veterans Pension Net Worth — Declared One-Time Payments in Annual Income
content:
**Desk card — Veterans Pension net worth.** Annual income in the redetermined net worth adds the one-time payments the veteran declared, by the age of his most recently received declaration, counted in days from the date VA received it to the redetermination:

- **90 days or fewer (the fresh period):** its full amount is added.
- **More than 90 days but within one year (365 days):** its amount times the months left of its twelve-month year divided by 12 is added — the months left being 12 less the whole months since it was received — rounded to the cent.
- **No declaration within one year:** nothing is added.

| Declaration of 4800.00 received (hypothetical) | Whole months since | Added to annual income |
|---|---|---|
| 30 days before | — | 4800.00 |
| 140 days before | 4 | 4800.00 times 8 divided by 12: 3200.00 |
| 300 days before | 9 | 4800.00 times 3 divided by 12: 1200.00 |
| 400 days before, or none on file | — | 0.00 |
